examples.en: I wear comfortable leggings when I exercise.
These leggings stretch well, so they are comfortable.
The leggings were small, so I changed them to a bigger size.
I wore a long T-shirt over black leggings.

examples.ko: 동생이 새 레깅스도 사고 양말도 샀어요.
examples.en: My younger sibling bought new leggings and socks too.
I came to yoga class after changing into leggings.

explain: 바지처럼 '입다'와 같이 써요. 영어 leggings처럼 s가 붙은 모양이지만 한국어는 복수 표시가 따로 없어서 하나든 여러 개든 '레깅스'예요. 헐렁한 '바지'와 달리 몸에 붙는 옷을 말할 때 써요.
explain_en: Like '바지', it goes with the verb '입다'. It looks plural in English, but Korean has no plural marker, so 레깅스 is used for one pair or many. You use it for a close-fitting garment, unlike a loose '바지'.

examples.en: Mornings and evenings are chilly, so I bought a windbreaker.

examples.ko: 바람막이는 가볍고 얇아서 가방에 쏙 들어가요.
examples.en: A windbreaker is light and thin, so it fits easily in a bag.

examples.ko: 바람막이 점퍼를 입으니까 바람이 하나도 안 느껴져요.
examples.en: With a windbreaker jacket on, I can't feel any wind.

examples.ko: 집 앞의 큰 나무가 바람막이가 되어 줘요.
examples.en: The big tree in front of the house acts as a windbreak.

examples.ko: 이 바람막이에 모자가 달려 있어서 비 올 때도 좋아요.
examples.en: This windbreaker has a hood, so it's good when it rains too.

examples.ko: 바람막이로 쓸 만한 얇은 겉옷을 찾고 있어요.
examples.en: I'm looking for a thin jacket that works as a windbreaker.

explain: 옷으로는 '바람막이 점퍼'를 줄여서 그냥 '바람막이'라고 해요. 바람을 막아 주는 나무나 벽 같은 것도 '바람막이'라고 불러요.
explain_en: As clothing, '바람막이 점퍼' is shortened to just '바람막이'. Trees or walls that block the wind are also called '바람막이'.

examples.en: These frames are thin, so they're light and comfortable.
I changed the frame color from black to brown.

examples.ko: 얼굴이 둥글어서 각진 안경테가 잘 어울려요.
examples.en: My face is round, so angular frames suit me well.
The frame was bent, so I took it to the optician's.

examples.ko: 안경테만 새로 사고 렌즈는 그대로 썼어요.
examples.en: I bought only new frames and kept the same lenses.
Expensive frames don't break easily.

explain: 렌즈(안경알)를 제외한 틀 부분이에요. 귀에 거는 부분은 따로 '안경다리'라고 불러요. 안경을 고를 때는 '테'와 '렌즈'를 따로 골라요.
explain_en: It is the frame part of glasses, without the lenses ('안경알'). The part that goes over the ears is called '안경다리' separately. When buying glasses, you choose the frame and the lenses separately.

examples.en: I made kimchi stew with pork foreleg meat.

examples.ko: 고양이가 앞다리를 쭉 뻗고 기지개를 켰어요.
examples.en: The cat stretched out its front legs and had a good stretch.
The puppy scratched my knee with its front paw.
The horse raised its front legs and neighed loudly.
A rabbit's hind legs are much longer than its front legs.
Since falling, the puppy has been limping on its front leg.

explain: 주로 동물의 앞쪽 다리를 말하고, 반대말은 '뒷다리'예요. 사람의 팔은 '앞다리'라고 하지 않고 '팔'이라고 해요. 요리에서는 '앞다리살'이라는 고기 부위 이름으로도 자주 나와요.
explain_en: It mainly means the front legs of an animal, and the opposite is '뒷다리'. A person's arm is just called '팔', not '앞다리'. It also appears often in cooking as the meat cut '앞다리살'.

examples.en: I wore jeans for the bottoms.
I matched the colors of the top and bottom.
This store sells bottoms separately.
The bottoms are too long, so I need to have them shortened.
I wear comfortable bottoms when I exercise.
A stain got on the bottoms, so I took them to the laundry.

explain: '상의'(윗옷)의 짝말이에요. 바지와 치마를 함께 가리키는 말이라 옷 가게나 쇼핑몰에서 볼 수 있어요. 일상 대화에서는 '바지', '치마'처럼 구체적인 이름을 써도 돼요.
explain_en: It is the partner of '상의' (top). It covers pants and skirts together, so you see it in clothing shops and online stores. In everyday talk you can use specific words like '바지' or '치마'.
